title: product/v1 frontmatter (AIP-53)
description: Validates the YAML frontmatter portion of an AIP-53 PRODUCT.md — a sellable thing with a kind and a price. A product REFERENCES existing AIP artifacts (an AIP-42 app, AIP-52 pack, AIP-10 knowledge, a git repo, a manuscript) but is not one of them; it carries the commerce fields (price, billing rail) that those doctypes deliberately omit. Doctype discriminator: 'product/v1'.

amountMinor.description: Amount in MINOR units of the currency (cents for usd). Minor units are normative — major-unit floats are the x100 bug class.

model.description: Buy a pool of meter units up front; consumption draws the pool down. Pool STATE is host-side — the rail only initiates the top-up payment.

unitPriceMinor.description: Price per unit in minor units of the currency.

grantUnits.description: Meter units granted per purchase. Unit semantics are declared by the host, not the spec; if a wallet asset backs the pool, units MUST be minor units of that asset's `decimals`.

model.description: Post-paid metering: each unit consumed is billed.

unitPriceMinor.description: Price per meter unit in minor units.

meter.description: Host-declared meter id, e.g. 'agent-call', 'tokens-1k'. Open vocabulary; hosts SHOULD namespace host-specific meters.

productId.description: Stripe Product id — a CACHE of the last projection, never the source of truth for the price.

priceId.description: Stripe Price id. For pay-per-call, Stripe's separate Meter object id MUST be carried in `meterId`, not overloaded here.

meterId.description: Stripe Meter id — REQUIRED when price.model is 'pay-per-call'; Stripe meters are created out-of-band and cannot be derived from the Price id.

recurrence.description: Billing recurrence for metered prices. Absent = per-unit without period.

featureId.description: Autumn feature id. Autumn natively models both metered usage and prepaid credit grants, so prepaid-pool and pay-per-call both project onto one featureId.

grantId.description: Autumn credit-grant id for prepaid-pool products, if distinct from featureId.

rail.description: Commerce shape decided, provider not chosen yet.
Vendor-specific rail. Rail-specific config lives under namespaced keys; unknown rails MUST be tolerated by hosts that only consume the price union.

kind.description: Manuscript/corpus with NO backing AIP artifact — a plain relative path or URL. Deliberately unresolvable by any registry.

appRef.description: The AIP-42 app's `id`. By-reference, NOT an inlined handle: AIP-42 AppHandles do not carry a `schema` field and serialize to the whole bundle — inlining fights `attach` and bloats the manifest. Resolution is host-side (install the app, or look the id up in an AIP-43 registry with `family: 'app'`; anonymous AIP-42 apps without an `id` CANNOT be sold — hosts MUST refuse). Hosts SHOULD record the app's version at sale time.

version.description: App version pinned at sale time. Optional; absent = floating.

packRef.description: The AIP-52 pack's `name` (packs key on `name`, not `id`). If a pack also carries its own `pricing` block, THIS product's price is authoritative; hosts SHOULD warn on divergence.

pack.description: Path to a knowledge-cascade pack directory or an AIP-10 workspace name.

kind.description: Vendor-specific target kind. SHOULD be namespaced (e.g. 'wallet-credit-pool'); if a wallet asset backs it, ref MUST be the AIP-49 `AssetRef`.

What is being sold. MUST equal target.kind when target is present (cross-field rule, enforced in defineProduct's validate, not in JSON Schema). Core vocabulary: content | repo | app | pack | knowledge-pack; open to vendor kinds.

title.description: Human-readable display name, e.g. a checkout label.

version.description: Semver of the product itself, independent of the price.

price.description: The source of truth for what is charged. billingRail is projection config; a generator derives Stripe Prices / Autumn features FROM this.

target.description: What the buyer receives. Optional — a product MAY be priced without a target (e.g. a pure credit pool top-up); the `kind`/`target.kind` agreement is validated in defineProduct.

metadata.description: Vendor-specific extensions, namespaced under <vendor>. Hosts MUST tolerate unknown keys.
